entry_point: render(component, instance_id, duration_seconds, content_data, local_semantic_cues, locale)
rules: Episodes call the renderer rather than copying or replacing component CSS.
The handbook and films must use the same renderer version and source hashes.
Release snapshots are explicit and immutable after delivery; upgrades are intentional.
Scenes contain content and cue configuration, not arbitrary component x/y coordinates.
A new generic variant is documented with another subject and actually rendered before release.
Every generated instance records parent family, version, data, cues and reading order.
Choose a component for the explanatory task, not implementation convenience; inspect base designs as well as production variants.
Explanatory cards and diagrams use visibly moving, softly blurred video backgrounds; intentional full-frame exceptions record a reason.
Validate image and label obstacles, connector clearance, alignment, and caption-safe bounds during motion as well as at rest.

map-decision.directions: all directions; proposed route uses a dashed path

feedback-loop.geometry: Three image nodes, reserved connector lanes, short single-line labels

evidence-collage.geometry: Two source artifacts with separate reading areas and a clear connecting lane

context-reveal.geometry: One media placement widens inside a fixed clipping window
